en: Old Spanish postal card with cream background and handwritten black ink address. The heading reads "Tarjeta Postal – Unión Postal Universal – España". A red 10-centimos Spanish stamp with a portrait is affixed in the upper-right corner and postmarked. The left side contains diagonally written sender information, while the center and bottom right show the addressee's name and location, including "La Magdalena" and "Santander".
